name: Possibility and necessity (a branching episode)
description: A diachronic, mark-free reading of ◇ and □ (docs/MODALITY_WITHOUT_GAMMA.md): the branching history is the Kripke frame, so ◇φ = 'some legal trajectory scribes φ' and □φ = 'every legal trajectory scribes φ'. From a morning (cloudy)(cold)(calm), two lines of development each drop a feature and converge on (cold). Across the reachable sheets, (cold) is necessary (□ — on every trajectory), while (cloudy) and (calm) are each merely possible (◇ — on some). Read off the DAG by src/modal_query.py; no broken cut, no tincture — necessity is convergence, possibility is branching.
